messages:
Sasha: quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

Sasha: What I did: ran the spanish prompt onboarding eval against llama3-smallq; found a ~12% drop in factuality on the synth spanish set vs baseline. Also sanity-checked KV cache behavior on long convo sims.
Sasha: Blockers: need a quick code review on the prompt normalization change (PR #452) and a deploy window for a canary run. kv-cache seems to evict earlier than expected when sequence > 1024, might be a config mismatch.
Sasha: Today: will push a small fix for prompt whitespace normalization + re-run the eval. If someone can review PR #452 and kick a canary that'll help. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452

Priya: On it — will review PR #452 after lunch (ETA ~13:30 PT). I skimmed and the diff looks small, mostly stripping/normalizing whitespace and collapsing repeated tokens.
Priya: Quick note: normalization could affect reranker inputs; I'll add a smoke eval to ensure reranker precision doesn't regress.

Mike: I can also take a look. Heads up: batch defaults might amplify the failure — saw similar with DEFAULT_BATCH=16.
Mike: Suggest changing default to 8 in the canary: `DEFAULT_BATCH = 8` and watch latency.

Kevin: reproducing locally now. Running the spanish prompt set with the current binary and a slightly longer context to stress KV. Command: `./scripts/run_eval --model llama3-smallq --prompts prompts_es.json --max-seq 1500`
Kevin: If KV evicts at ~1024, likely a kernel/alloc mismatch. Will paste logs if I see the eviction trace.

Nina: FYI ops — I can open a canary window at 16:00 PT for 30m. Need approvals from @Priya and @Mike before I flip. Deploy-bot will annotate the rollout.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for infra/pr-452 at 2025-07-13T16:00:00-07:00 (16:00 PT). Will run on dedicated pool: dd-llama3-smallq-canary.

Priya: Approved for canary. I'll run the reranker smoke (10k tokens total) during the window.

Mike: Approved. I'll monitor latency/throughput and watch the failrate metric. If token error rate > 1% or latency P95 increases > 30% revert.

Sasha: Thanks all. Kevin — ping me the eviction logs when you have them.

Kevin: quick log snippet I see: `kv_cache: eviction_trigger sequence_len=1508, active_kv_size=980MB, max_kv_bytes=768MB` — looks like a config cap.
Kevin: filing a small infra issue to bump allowed kv bytes for the canary.

Sasha: OK that's helpful — sounds like we should bump kv cap for the canary, run, and if that stabilizes, make a follow-up config roll for prod.

Priya: After canary I'll post a mini-report in this thread with reranker precision + example failures.

Mike: If anyone wants a quick review of the perf dashboard query I'm running, here's the gist: `SELECT count(*) FROM inference_errors WHERE model='llama3-smallq' AND time > now() - 30m` — will share exact dashboard link post-canary.

Sasha: Final asks: (1) PR review — Priya/Mike, (2) canary at 16:00 PT — Nina to flip, (3) Kevin to run repro + attach logs, (4) I'll re-run the spanish eval and post results. Back in ~2.5h with numbers. :thumbsup:

Priya: Copy — ping me if you need extra prompt examples.

Kevin: Uploaded logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/sessions/kv-evict-1755554321

Sasha: Awesome, thanks team.
